Section 19 of the Constitution is amended -Amendment of

text.en:
Section 19 of the Constitution is amended -Amendment of section 19.

(a) by deleting the words "the Council shall, on the advice of the Vice-Chancellor" in sub-section ( 1) and substituting therefor "the Vice-Chancellor shall, after consultation with the Council",

(b) by deleting the words-"the Council may, on the advice of the Vice-Chancellor" in sub-section (6) and substituting therefor ''the Vice-Chancellor may, after consultation with the Council."

heading.en: The Constitution is amended by deleting sub-section ( 1) of section Amendment of

text.en: The Constitution is amended by deleting sub-section ( 1) of section Amendment of 22 and substituting therefor the following -section 22. '' ( 1) There shall be established a Board of Student Welfare consisting of a Chairman and such other persons as may be appointed by the Vice-Chancellor.''

heading.en: The Constitution is amended by deleting sub-section ( 1) of section Amendment of

text.en:
The Constitution is amended by deleting sub-section ( 1) of section Amendment of 51 and substituting therefor the following -· section 51. "(1) The disciplinary authority of the University in respect of every student of the University shall be the Deputy ViceChancellor or, if there are more than one Deputy Vice-Chancellor, such one of them as may be named by the Vice-Chancellor, or, if there is no Deputy Vice-Chancellor, such staff member or officer of the University as may be named by the Vice-Chancellor to be the disciplinary authority." Made this 19th day of September, 1991, at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
